shared_elements: upright slab/stela carved in low relief with a filled figural surface
content divided into stacked horizontal registers
anthropomorphic/limbed figure with arms rendered schematically
sinuous serpent-like or curved elongated forms in the lower zone
horizontal band of repeated pattern separating registers
justification: Both surfaces are tall upright slabs covered edge-to-edge with flat, schematic low-relief imagery organised into stacked horizontal registers, with limbed anthropomorphic-looking figures above and elongated sinuous/animal forms in the lowest zone, which gives a broadly similar overall impression. But the specific motifs differ: A shows an identifiable row of arched animal figures, a distinct profile quadruped with a small crouching figure beneath it, and clearly rendered long-necked birds, whereas B centres on a single frontal figure with outstretched arms and flanking devices over a paired scroll-like lower register, so no distinctive motif recurs in the same relationship.
